REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 14, 2021 - 07:00 P.M.
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID # 815 6284 3861
LEGISLATIVE BODY MEMBERS MAY PARTICIPATE FROM THE COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, OR VIA TELECONFERENCE AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20
* THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER REMAINS CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC *
INSTRUCTIONS FOR PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN THIS MEETING ARE LISTED BELOW
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, and in compliance with the current Los Angeles County Health Officer Order, the City Council Chamber remains closed to the public. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 this meeting will be conducted via teleconference. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after the distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at 562-916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or by connecting to the ZOOM meeting described below.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting using any of the following methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: Live audio public comments can be made by connecting to the meeting using the information listed below. Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time during the meeting agenda and must be available at the time they are called upon to speak.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81562843861
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 815 6284 3861
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD JANUARY 14,
2021, 7:00 P.M., IN HYBRID MODE FROM THE COUNCIL CHAMBER, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA AND VIA TELECONFERENCE AS AUTHORIZED BY
STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO
COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 815 6284 3861

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  Proclamations were made by the City Council as follows:

  Sharon and Ralph Salisbury (in honor of their 60th Wedding Anniversary, December 30,
  2020).

5B.  Closed Session Report (December 10, 2020, 7:00 p.m., City Council/Successor
  Agency Regular Meeting and December 16, 2020, 2:00 p.m. City
  Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting).

  Pam Lee, Interim City Attorney, provided the following Closed Session reports from the
  meetings listed below.

  December 10, 2020, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting

  The City Council met in Closed Session to discuss Item 12A as listed on the meeting
  agenda:

  12A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(b) (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney

  With regard to Item 12A, the City Council discussed the matter and no reportable
  action was taken. This concluded the Closed Session report from this meeting.

5.  Presentations/Appointments (continued)

5B.  (continued)

  December 16, 2020, 2:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting

  The City Council met in Closed Session to discuss Item 5A as listed on the meeting
  agenda:

  5A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(b) (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney

  With regard to Item 5A, the City Council discussed the matter and the following
  reportable action was taken:

  VOTE: Pam K. Lee was appointed to serve as Interim City Attorney (COUNCIL).

  The vote carried (3 - 2) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo
  NOES:  Barrows, Solanki
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  This concluded the Closed Session report from this meeting.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Noting there were no individuals who provided written correspondence or elected to
  speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes and Cerritos
  Public Financing Authority Special Meeting Minutes of December 10, 2020, 7:00 p.m.
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY/PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes and the Cerritos Public Financing
  Authority Special Meeting Minutes of December 10, 2020, 7:00 p.m.
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY/PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  January 14, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 3 of 8

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7A.  (continued)

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of December 16,
  2020, 2:00 p.m. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of December 16, 2020, 2:00 p.m.
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated January 14, 2021
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to approve the Register of
  Demands as follows:

  City of Cerritos  01/14/2021  $ 9,016,404.55 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of Treasurer’s Reports

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending
  November 30, 2020 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending November 30, 2020
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.
 City of Cerritos  January 14, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 4 of 8

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational update on the City's response to the
  COVID-19 local emergency (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  C. W. Van der Linden noted his appreciation for being acknowledged to speak, however,
  he had no further comments at the time.

  Daisy Legasca inquired regarding the number of doses to be given at COVID-19
  vaccination sites and whether there will be sites located in Cerritos.

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

9B.  Review and consideration of the proposed 2021 City Council/Successor Agency Regular
  and Special Meeting Schedule (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Daisy Legasca congratulated the City Council on the Santa Sleigh Program and strongly
  encouraged its continuation.

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager and City Clerk to distribute, publish, and
  post agendas for Monday Special Meetings held in lieu of canceled Thursday Regular
  Meetings no later than the Wednesday prior to the Monday meeting.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to:

  1. Approve the 2021 City Council/Successor Agency Regular and Special Meeting
  Schedule as follows:

  Thursday, January 14, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting
  Thursday, January 28, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting
  Thursday, February 11, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting
  Thursday, February 25, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting

  Thursday, March 25, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting
  Thursday, April 8, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, April 21, 2021  Annual Mayoral Transition (non-election year)
  Thursday, April 22, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  (continued)

  Monday, May 10, 2021  Council/Agency Special Meeting
  Thursday, May 13, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting (canceled)
  Monday, May 17, 2021  FY 2021/2022 Budget Study Session (1st)
  Thursday, May 27, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting
  Thursday, June 3, 2021  FY 2021/2022 Budget Study Session (2nd)
  Thursday, June 10, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting
  Thursday, June 24, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting - Budget adoption
  Thursday, July 8, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting

  Monday, September 27, 2021 Council/Agency Special Meeting
  Thursday, October 14, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting
  Thursday, October 28, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting
  Monday, November 8, 2021  Council/Agency Special Meeting
  Thursday, November 11, 2021 Council/Agency Regular Meeting (canceled)
  Monday, November 22, 2021  Council/Agency Special Meeting, Tree Lighting Event
  Thursday, November 25, 2021 Council/Agency Regular Meeting (canceled)
  Thursday, December 9, 2021  Council/Agency Regular Meeting
  Thursday, December 23, 2021 Council/Agency Regular Meeting (canceled); and

  2. Direct the City Manager and City Clerk to distribute, publish, and post agendas for
  Monday Special Meetings held in lieu of canceled Thursday Regular Meetings no later
  than the Wednesday prior to the Monday meeting (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of award of contract for the boiler replacement at the Cerritos
  Olympic Swim Center, Project No. 20201, Bid No. 1414-21 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to:

  1. Reject the sole bid submitted for the boiler replacement at the Cerritos Olympic
  Swim Center, Project No. 20201, Bid No. 1414-21; and

  2. Authorize the appropriation and expenditure of funds in an amount not to exceed
  $60,000 for the temporary repair of the existing boiler at the Cerritos Olympic Swim
  Center; and
 City of Cerritos  January 14, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 6 of 8

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  (continued)

  3. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any change orders related to
  the boiler repairs; and

  4. Direct staff to re-evaluate and modify the scope of the project, and to re-advertise
  for bids at a future date (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9D.  Review and consideration of award of contract for the removal and application of plaster
  at the Cerritos Olympic Swim Center, Project No. 20201, Bid No. 1415-21 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  C.W. Van der Linden spoke expressing concern regarding the City’s existing water
  filtration system and inquired as to the type of plaster that will be utilized to complete
  the project.

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to:

  1. Authorize the appropriation and expenditure of funds in the amount of $288,250 for
  the removal and application of plaster at the Cerritos Olympic Swim Center from the
  Los Angeles County Supervisor’s Grant; and

  2. Award a contract to California Commercial Pools in the amount of $288,250 for the
  removal and application of plaster at the Cerritos Olympic Swim Center, Project No.
  20201, Bid No. 1415-21, and reject the other bids; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any project-related change
  orders (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  January 14, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 7 of 8

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9E.  Review and consideration of award of contract for the fabrication and installation of new
  bulkheads at the Cerritos Olympic Swim Center, Project No. 20201, Bid No. 1413-21
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  provided written correspondence or elected to speak, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to:

  1. Award a contract to California Waters Development, Inc. in the amount of $575,009
  for the fabrication and installation of new bulkheads at the Cerritos Olympic Swim
  Center, Project No. 20201, Bid No. 1413-21, and reject the other bids; and

  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any project-related change
  orders (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9F.  Review and consideration of award of sole source contracts for the repair and
  rehabilitation of the natural gas engine at the City’s C-1 well and the replacement of the
  heat exchanger at the City’s C-2 booster station (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works/Water &
  Power, and Javier Martinez, Water Superintendent. A PowerPoint presentation was
  displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  C.W. Van der Linden spoke expressing his satisfaction with the work of the City’s new
  Water Superintendent.

  Noting there were no other individuals who provided written correspondence or elected
  to speak, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to:

  1. Find that staff has satisfied the purpose of the bidding regulations of the Cerritos
  Municipal Code; and

  2. Find that it is reasonable and necessary to sole source the service and repairs of the
  Waukesha Natural Gas Engine at the C-1 well and the replacement of the heat
  exchanger at the C-2 booster station in accordance with Section 3.20.060 of the City
  of Cerritos Municipal Code, due to Waukesha-Pearce Industries, Inc. (WPI) being the
  only service provider in California authorized to perform engine overhauls for
  Waukesha engines, and Support Product Services, Inc. (SPS) being the only
  distributer of the required heat exchanger; and
 City of Cerritos  January 14, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 8 of 8

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9F.  (continued)

  3. Authorize the appropriation and expenditure of funds in an amount not to exceed
  $180,615.65 for the service and repairs of the Waukehsa Natural Gas Engine at the
  C-1 well and the replacement of the heat exchanger at the C-2 booster station; and

  4. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to approve any change orders that may
  become necessary to complete the defined scope of work as described in the agenda
  report (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  Councilmember Barrows requested the City Manager review pending legislation,
  including conferring with the City’s lobbyist, and provide a report as to whether the City
  Council should formally take a position on the following items: SEA2, SB 6, SB 15, AB
  68, ACA 1, SB 5, SB 8, SB 9, and SB 10.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Barrows and Yokoyama, Mayor Pro Tem Vo,
  and Mayor Solanki.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to plan a community Town Hall
  meeting regarding the Metro West Santa Ana Branch Light Rail Project.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to upgrade the City Council
  Chamber audiovisual systems to support a high definition (HD) experience.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:52 p.m.

  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
